description_en: Calls the ModifyActiveOperationTasks operation to modify the scheduled switchover time of O&M tasks
description_zh: 调用ModifyActiveOperationTasks接口修改运维任务的计划切换时间
name: ModifyActiveOperationTasks

parameters.description_en:
The O&M task IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

> You can call [DescribeActiveOperationTasks](~~414458~~) to obtain O&M task IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
运维任务ID，多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

> 您可以调用[DescribeActiveOperationTasks](~~414458~~)获取运维任务ID。
parameters.help_en:
The O&M task IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

> You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/414458.html to obtain O&M task IDs
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务ID，多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/414458.html获取运维任务ID
parameters.name: ids

parameters.description_en:
The scheduled switchover time to set. Specify the time in the _yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ_ format (UTC).

> The time cannot be later than the deadline. You can call [DescribeActiveOperationTasks](~~414458~~) and check the value of the **Deadline** response parameter to obtain the deadline.
parameters.description_zh:
要设置的计划切换时间，格式为_yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ_（UTC时间）。

> 不能晚于最晚操作时间，您可以调用[DescribeActiveOperationTasks](~~414458~~)，通过返回参数**Deadline**的值来获取最晚操作时间。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to immediately execute the O&M task. Valid values:

- **1**: immediately executes the task.
- **0**: executes the task at the specified time.
parameters.description_zh:
是否立即执行运维任务，取值：

- **1**：立即执行。
- **0**：指定时间执行。
